verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own MCP server supports 'Guides': markdown documents that capture an org's metric definitions, join conventions, and domain context so AI agents produce consistent SQL. That is a first-party, AI-facing approximation of a semantic layer. But Guides are free-form prose consumed by agents, not a declared, governed model of metrics, dimensions, and joins that SQL queries and BI tools resolve against. The dbt adapter integration is a third-party path and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: structured metric/dimension/join declarations, enforcement or governance of definitions, consistent resolution for non-AI SQL/BI queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
